viteServerProcessTree.attribution: shared pre-existing server; activity cannot be attributed only to this app

limitations: Application group excludes the separately sampled Vite server. When shared, Vite CPU/RSS/I/O can include unrelated clients and activity and is not attributable only to this app. Each process-group RSS sums resident pages and can double-count shared memory; storage IO is not network traffic; short-lived children between polls may be missed.
